'''Matthew Gountis''' is a competitive Star Wars CCG player documented from Players Committee tournament sources. He was listed as ''Matthew Gauntley'' in the wiki's first transcription of the 2009 Worlds lists; both 2009 sheets are printed ''Matthew Gountis''.<ref>[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D2.pdf 2009 Worlds Day 2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 42–43.</ref>
